ap_definition: Official pycocotools COCO 101-recall-point AP; all areas, maxDets=100. AP50 is IoU 0.5; mAP50_95 averages IoU thresholds 0.50:0.05:0.95.
precision_recall_definition: Single-class greedy matching at IoU >= 0.5, confidence >= 0.25, across all test images.
timing_definition: inference_ms: synchronized RGB conversion, resizing, tensor/device transfer, forward pass, postprocessing, and CPU box transfer. model_inference_ms: forward pass only. processing_ms additionally includes image reading, matching/recording detections, drawing, and saving. Model loading, warm-up, and AP computation are excluded.
visualization: test contains all original filenames; red boxes are predictions at confidence >= 0.25; green boxes are ground truth, drawn on top.
path_definition: Report paths are relative to the repository root; configuration dataset paths are relative to method3_two_stage.
